native.pcie_implementation: Actual controller/firmware family; registered actual values distinct reviewed Altera implementation.
native.pcie_mode: Actual negotiated FLIT status, independent generation capability or downtraining.
native.pcie_encoding: Actual link coding, lower-rate FLIT needs an explicitly qualified coding source.
native.pcie_role: Actual port role; PCIe is not a multi-master CAN bus.
native.pcie_traffic: Actual posted/nonposted/completion transaction flow; distinct frame class and service acceptance.
native.pcie_clock: Actual common/separate reference clock configuration and partner compatibility.
native.pcie_link_state: Actual LTSSM/low-power state, not a speed capability.
native.pcie_outcome: Actual correlated application acceptance, distinct successful link training.
native.pcie_address_space: Actual memory/IO/configuration request; their payload and completion rules differ.
native.pcie_edition_source: Actual Base/CEM/ECN edition and enabled feature set. Public source review is not full conformance.
native.pcie_device_source: Actual device capabilities, register snapshot and configured values on each hop.
native.pcie_link_source: Actual trained generation/width/mode, lane layout and link status at this hop.
native.pcie_schedule_source: Actual per-direction traffic, credits/backpressure/replay/power-state service bounds.
native.pcie_transaction_source: Actual request/completion tags, lengths, addresses, ordering and error status.
native.pcie_acceptance_source: Actual application age/deadline/validity and correlated consumption evidence.
native.pcie_clock_source: Actual partner clock capability and measured implementation tolerances.
native.pcie_address_hex: Actual 32/64-bit request address encoded losslessly as hexadecimal, not floating-point number.
native.pcie_ordering_source: Actual relaxed/no-snoop/VC/TC mapping and end-to-end coherency contract.
native.pcie_link_status_hex: Actual four hexadecimal digits for the Link Status register, decoded losslessly against generation/lanes/training/active values.
native.pcie_generation: Actual negotiated generation1..7, not maximum card capability or hypothetical Gen8 draft.
native.pcie_lanes: Actual negotiated width; independent slot mechanical width and bifurcation.
native.pcie_rate_gts: Actual per-lane transfer rate GT/s, not byte throughput or PAM4 baud.
native.pcie_raw_direction_bps: Derived raw aggregate one-direction bit rate, before codec/packets/credits/replay/power gaps.
native.pcie_decoded_ceiling_bps: Theoretical NON_FLIT decoded bit ceiling; not application goodput/capacity evidence.
native.pcie_mps: Actual configured Max_Payload_Size, independent read request length.
native.pcie_mps_supported: Actual read-only device MPS capability, not configured MPS.
native.pcie_path_mps: Actual compatible maximum payload along every traversed port/function.
native.pcie_mrrs: Actual configured Max_Read_Request_Size, may exceed configured MPS.
native.pcie_tlp_payload_bytes: Actual DWORD-aligned on-wire data of one TLP, includes disabled/padding bytes; distinct whole application/read request/completion.
native.pcie_request_bytes: Actual nonposted read request length, distinct response splitting into several completions.
native.pcie_remaining_bytes: Actual still outstanding completion bytes for same request, not full application buffer.
native.pcie_header_bytes: Actual NON_FLIT base header size from3DW/4DW; prefix/digest separately.
native.pcie_prefix_bytes: Actual enabled TLP prefix bytes; requires selected format/device source.
native.pcie_digest_bytes: Actual optional NON_FLIT ECRC digest, distinct link CRC.
native.pcie_lcrc_bytes: Actual NON_FLIT link checksum4bytes, not Ethernet FCS or FLIT CRC8.
native.pcie_framing_bytes: Actual selected coding framing/sequence overhead, no fixed Ethernet header.
native.pcie_packet_bytes: Actual NON_FLIT packet sum before line coding/SKP.
native.pcie_flit_bytes: Selected FLIT fixed whole unit size256.
native.pcie_flit_tlp_bytes: FLIT area236 for TLPs, not236application bytes guaranteed.
native.pcie_flit_dlp_bytes: FLIT data-link area6, distinct TLP data.
native.pcie_flit_fec_bytes: FLIT FEC6, no guaranteed application validity implied.
native.pcie_traffic_class: Actual TC0..7; not CAN arbitration priority.
native.pcie_virtual_channel: Actual mapped VC0..7 within enabled endpoint capabilities.
native.pcie_vc_count: Actual enabled virtual channel count, source-qualified arbitration/backpressure.
native.pcie_header_credits: Actual available usable header credits for this flow/VC, not raw advertised counter.
native.pcie_data_credits: Actual available usable data credits, distinct scaled/modular advertised limit.
native.pcie_data_credit_bytes: Reviewed data-credit size16bytes for selected Altera NON_FLIT interface.
native.pcie_needed_data_credits: Data credits needed, rounded up on actual TLP data bytes.
native.pcie_tag_bits: Actual enabled requester tag width, not all generations always8.
native.pcie_tag: Actual outstanding tag under enabled width and correlated requester/function.
native.pcie_tag_capacity: Actual supported outstanding tags for selected controller.
native.pcie_outstanding_requests: Actual currently allocated request tags, no duplicate reuse while outstanding.
native.pcie_requester_device: Actual conventional BDF device identifier; ARI requires registered interpretation.
native.pcie_requester_function: Actual conventional BDF function0..7; ARI source-qualified separately.
native.pcie_completion_timeout_us: Actual device timeout selection, not a copied CAN or generic50ms default.
native.pcie_completion_elapsed_us: Actual elapsed nonposted request time at observation.
native.pcie_replay_bound_us: Actual ACK/NAK/replay service bound for active format/rate/width/device.
native.pcie_wake_bound_us: Actual power-state exit latency, not always zero.
native.pcie_age_us: Actual source-data age at correlated application consumption.
native.pcie_reset_wait_us: Actual Conventional Reset configuration-request wait; separate link-training duration.
native.pcie_link_status: Actual16-bit Link Status register snapshot, source-version qualified.
native.pcie_aer_uncorrectable: Actual32-bit AER uncorrectable status; not a CRC-success boolean.
native.pcie_aer_correctable: Actual32-bit AER correctable status, replay need not imply application failure.
native.pcie_page_offset: Actual request address low12bits, compared to the selected memory request span; not full64bit floating address.
native.pcie_flit_supported: Actual both-partner FLIT capability; separate negotiated status.
native.pcie_link_active: Actual Data Link Layer Link Active, separate physical speed.
native.pcie_training: Actual Link Training status; not a steady service bound.
native.pcie_ecrc_enabled: Actual optional end-to-end digest enable, not automatic all-packet validity.
native.pcie_ecrc_supported: Actual generator/checker capability for chosen direction.
native.pcie_relaxed_ordering: Actual selected ordering attribute requires application coherency evidence.
native.pcie_no_snoop: Actual selected no-snoop attribute, not safe by default for all memory.
native.pcie_completion_timeout_disabled: Actual disable setting; no timeout means no finite completion proof.
native.pcie_transmission_started: Actual TLP emission subject to link and usable credits.
native.pcie_completion_received: Actual completion received for correlated request/tag/function.
native.pcie_completion_success: Actual completion status Success, not only link ACK.
native.pcie_tag_unique: Actual outstanding tag uniqueness/correlation verified by source.
native.pcie_data_accepted: Actual functional consumption, separate raw rate/CRC/physical qualification.
native.pcie_readiness_notification: Actual RN mechanism used after Conventional Reset.
native.pcie_conventional_reset: Actual reset event; not every power transition.
native.payload_bytes: Whole application bytes, distinct one DWORD-aligned TLP, MPS, MRRS, path capabilities, FLIT packing and actual flow-control service. No universal CAN8/Ethernet1500 ceiling.
